verdict: Organic search is holding you up; paid campaigns are offline.
narrative: All activity this period came through your Google Business Profile — paid advertising on Meta and Google ran zero spend and produced zero leads across the full 28 days. Your GBP drove 46 total actions including 27 direction requests, 17 website clicks, and 2 calls, with a strong 160% spike in the most recent 7 days; however, the last few days of the period show that spike beginning to cool. Website sessions also softened week-over-week, so we are watching both signals closely. Conversion tracking on the website is being repaired, which means form submissions during this period are likely under-reported.

highlights.phrase: total actions from your Google Business Profile in the last 28 days
GBP activity growth in the most recent 7-day stretch vs. the prior 7 days
website sessions in the last 28 days, all driven by organic traffic

watch_item.issue: Paid campaigns are fully offline, leaving organic GBP as your only lead source — and the GBP spike shows early signs of receding.
watch_item.fix: Paid campaign reactivation is being prioritized so lead flow does not depend on a single organic channel heading into the next period.
